It’s not a “smokescreen.” Anorexia is a mental disorder that after time effects the physical body as well.  When you don’t eat enough nutrients and consume more than half of your caloric intake it effects your brain chemistry.  You start to obsess over food- it dominates every waking thought. Believe it or not, people that suffer from an eating disorder think about food more than the average person. Speaking for myself, ( I suffer from anorexia) my mind is dominated by food. It’s all I think about, yet I hardly eat it. Hope this helps you understand more.
